summary: Ansible 11.2 community.general deprecations: defining debug in ModuleHelper subclasses, the atomic_container, atomic_host and atomic_image modules (removed in 13.0.0), facter (use community.general.facter_facts), locale_gen ubuntu_mode/ubuntu_legacy, the proxmox update default, and the pure module utils.
questions: What replaces the community.general facter module?
Are the atomic_host and atomic_container modules deprecated?
Will proxmox update default to true?
